mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent SET agent_id = #{agentId}, agent_name = #{agentName}, description = #{description}, channel = #{channel}, strategy = #{strategy}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_agent SET agent_name = #{agentName}, description = #{description}, channel = #{channel}, strategy = #{strategy}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, agent_id, agent_name, description, channel, strategy, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_agent WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, agent_id, agent_name, description, channel, strategy, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_agent WHERE channel = #{channel} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, agent_id, agent_name, description, channel, strategy, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_agent ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.agent_id, a.agent_name, a.description, a.channel, a.strategy, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, COUNT(DISTINCT afc.id) AS flow_step_count FROM ai_agent a INNER JOIN ai_agent_flow_config afc ON a.agent_id = afc.agent_id INNER JOIN ai_client c ON afc.client_id = c.client_id AND c.status = 1 WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.strategy = 'flowAgentExecuteStrategy' GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.agent_name, a.description, a.channel, a.strategy, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT afc.id) > 0 ORDER BY a.create_time ASC, a.id ASC

SELECT a.id, a.agent_id, a.agent_name, a.description, a.channel, a.strategy, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, COUNT(DISTINCT afc.id) AS flow_step_count FROM ai_agent a INNER JOIN ai_agent_flow_config afc ON a.agent_id = afc.agent_id INNER JOIN ai_client c ON afc.client_id = c.client_id AND c.status = 1 WHERE a.agent_id = #{agentId} AND a.status = 1 AND a.strategy = 'flowAgentExecuteStrategy' GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.agent_name, a.description, a.channel, a.strategy, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT afc.id) > 0
